verdict.rationale: Brevo's pricing page documents A/B testing of subject lines or content variants aimed at improving opens and clicks, so the core testing capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence says a winner is picked automatically from real engagement. The only evidence is one thin marketing line. Missing for 10: documented automatic winner selection based on engagement metrics (opens/clicks), configuration details (test split size, test duration, winning criteria), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement

citations.quote: Test subject lines or content variants to improve opens and clicks.
